instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "List the devices registered to show or read my notices", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:my-notification-devices and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Returns each registered device by opaque device_id, route, label and status.
4. It reads only its own rows, from the rows its caller gives it: notification-device.
